name: Mayonaka o Kiritotte
source:
Main heroine wanders around the night streets. She meets a boy and gets involved in an incidents. Will she safely escape and reveal the mystery?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-september-2004-abandoner.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
女主人公徘徊在夜晚的街头。她遇见一名少年，并被卷入一连串事件。她能否平安脱身并揭开谜团？

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-september-2004-abandoner.html]vndbreview[/url]]
